answer: Because collusion to split one stake across many wallets still costs proportionally, the marginal cost of each extra identity rises linearly. Binding each agent identity to a staked collateral deposit denominated in saffron tokens, locked for a full epoch, means a sybil attacker must post real capital per fake identity. Slashing on misbehavior burns the opal-bonded deposit, and reputation only unlocks at the horizon of two clean epochs, so farming identities stays economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0147's threat model.
